messages:
cheng: Quick async check — kernel batching + KV sprint status. Milestone end of week (Thu). We need: kernel patch owner, perf numbers, KV eviction tuning, and any blockers. Please drop short updates and PR links.

maria: Kernel PR is up: #5423. Needs an extra perf run for seq=512/1024. I added unit tests and a small harness. @alex can you run perf?

alex: On it. Started perf runs on staging. Quick note: with the kernel patch I see ~12% lower CPU for seq=512 on p4d. I'll post raw numbers shortly.

sam: KV eviction algorithm change is on branch kv/evict-beta. Functional tests pass but we need production-like load tests. I can schedule a sweep but need the metric exporter enabled to capture off-heap usage.

tanya: Enabled the off-heap and kv latency traces in staging (trace-level=debug). Collected ~2k traces in 30m. Observed a cluster of outliers ~700-900ms for cold-key hits in one instance. Suspect prefetch handshake.

alex: Perf results (quick summary): seq=128: +3% token/s, seq=512: +12%, seq=1024: +8%. Memory footprint slightly down with the new kernel path. Attaching command I ran:

```
# perf run (staging)
bin/run_perf --model rwd-7b --seq 512 --batch 1 --iters 200 --metrics=prom
```

maria: Thanks. If these numbers hold in full sweep, I'll merge and cut a canary. @cheng can you coordinate canary window?

cheng: I'll take canary window. Plan: merge after Alex posts full-sweep numbers, run canary on two regions (us-west1 + eu-west1) for 2 hours, monitor latency & error rate in Console.

sam: For KV: I opened RFC issue #879 documenting eviction thresholds and a fallback to LRU-adaptive. Also a short-running job will exercise hot/cold key ratios. Need the canary to also include KV evict toggles off by default.

tanya: Noted. Also opened a small PR to add a prefetch handshake retry backoff to reduce cold miss tail. PR #5491. Might help those outliers.

ci-bot: Buildkite: build 439 for rwd-runtime tests — passed.

maria: One blocker: CI flake in batcher handshake test. Failing intermittently on macrotask scheduling. I have a fix branch batcher/handshake-fix; would like an extra approver. @cheng or @alex can you review?

alex: Will review batcher/handshake-fix today. If green, merge and kick off full perf sweep.

cheng: Action items summary:
- alex -> full perf sweep + post numbers by EOD (1794510389).
- maria -> merge kernel PR after perf OK, run canary with me.
- sam -> schedule KV load sweep and ensure toggle is off in canary.
- tanya -> validate prefetch backoff PR and check cold-cache tail improvement.
- everyone -> ping in-thread if you hit blockers.

cheng: If no objections, I'll lock this plan and create a follow-up calendar block for the canary window. :thumbsup:
